snippet.title: The Crimson Deed Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The Crimson Deed is an immersive exploration based first person shooter starring Vesper, a vampire that has emerged from a long slumber into a world she no longer recognizes.
Explore the ruins of a fallen kingdom, and uncover the truth behind its downfall as you fend off vicious foes with powerful weapons and abilities!

Music by myuu - https://www.youtube.com/user/myuuji
